Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production environment background plate for an existing 2D walking game, 2304x1536 landscape, one continuous second-floor railway station waiting hall. This is ONLY FLOOR TWO, not a diagram.
Reference images: image 1 is the approved floorplan/style composition (use ONLY its upper-floor panel); image 2 is the existing game ground-floor art, authoritative for warm painterly materials, camera, paired escalator appearance and traveler proportions.
Primary request: build a spacious faithful upper waiting hall: cream tiled floor, chestnut wood and golden railings, blue signage, sunset windows showing distant Suzhou trees and pagoda. Fixed elevated frontal camera, mostly straight horizontal bench banks, playable broad aisles. Edges of building may fill canvas, no title, no margins, no exploded view, no text labels or diagram arrows.
Layout: rear wall across top quarter: compact snack shop at far left, cafe counter beside it, then rear-center arrival escalator well and adjacent lift, huge blank blue departure screen, Suzhou bridge mural, then far-right boarding approach. Toilets, help desk and two hot-water dispensers along left side below shops, exactly FOUR brown massage chairs in front-left. Twelve blue ordinary bench banks in three columns of four rows across middle, generous walkable aisles, empty seats. Boarding on right: short waist-high blue/steel ticket gates across bay with wide open approach NORTH/ABOVE gates, staffed accessible lane space. Partition only extends SOUTH from western gate end to protect checked landing. Broad landing immediately south of gates leads straight into broad descending stair mouth facing gates, then stair flight descends toward foreground, handrails only on sides, separate lift opening onto checked landing. No platform or train visible.
CRITICAL arrival geometry: this is upper floor. The paired escalators match ground-floor steel treads, black handrails, gold side trim: left lane travels down toward foreground, right lane travels up toward BACK/NORTH. They occupy a recessed opening in the floor, NOT a raised stair tower climbing to a third floor. Upper comb plates and exit onto 2F are at the NORTH/BACK end of this recessed well. A clear tiled rear aisle runs behind/north of their upper comb plates; travelers exit toward the back then turn around either side into waiting hall. The escalator flights slope DOWN inside the well toward the foreground to floor one. Keep entire railing/well well-defined with dark inner sidewalls below 2F level. Adjacent lift at rear wall. Both floor-one and floor-two steel lanes are paired with left down/right up. No ordinary ascending stairs at this arrival.
Paint exactly SIX environmental passengers, integrated with furniture, NOT standing in aisles: ONE sleeper lying horizontally across three adjacent seats of an armless blue bench near the arrival escalators (first row, leftmost ordinary bench), with head on backpack and a rolling suitcase at bench end; ONE passenger in leftmost massage chair with a small suitcase at feet; FOUR more seated travelers distributed among different blue benches, each with luggage at their feet or on an adjacent chair. All other chairs EMPTY, including cafe chairs, for live game actors later. The sleeper counts as one person. People are modestly small, in same painted style as reference, natural anatomy and grounded shadows. Every painted passenger has a visible bag. No staff, no mobile passengers, no panda, no player.
Signs and departure screen must be SOLID BLANK dark blue panels without ANY glyphs, numbers or pictograms; controlled labels will be drawn by game code. No text anywhere, no UI, no arrows. Keep the hall comfortably busy through furniture and six seated people but preserve circulation. High quality warm watercolor/gouache detailed background, NOT photorealistic or glossy 3D.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached new upper-floor game production plate. Keep its beautiful warm style, windows, shops, services, painted people with luggage, four massage chairs, blue blank signs, boarding gates and foreground-descending platform staircase.
CRITICAL FIX: the central paired escalators currently rise above the waiting-room floor like a staircase to floor three. REMOVE that raised escalator structure. Replace it with an unmistakable RECESSED RECTANGULAR ESCALATOR WELL CUT DOWN INTO THE SECOND-FLOOR TILED FLOOR. There is NO upright stair tower against the back wall. Fill the former top half of the raised escalator with continuous flat cream paving joining the surrounding floor and a tiled walkable rear landing behind the well. Move the well mouth and upper landing down to the same floor plane as shops' bases. Draw a rectangular hole at x480..630,y345..405 (proportional to this 1536x1024 image) surrounded by low gold/black guardrails. Inside the hole, two parallel steel tread lanes slope DOWN toward the near/front edge, visibly below room floor, with dark recessed sidewalls. Upper combs at BACK/NORTH side of hole open directly to a generous tiled aisle at y325; the LOWER front end disappears below floor into shadow. Back upper comb open, rails along sides only. No rail across upper exit. This must read as an arrival FROM THE FLOOR BELOW, not stairs climbing above this floor. Left lane down toward front, right lane up toward rear. Match the black handrails, gold trim, gray treads of existing escalators.
Keep sleeper bench nearby but separated from the well railing by a clear walking gap. His head must rest visibly on a small backpack and his rolling suitcase remains beside bench. Keep all SIX existing painted passengers and their luggage, no new people.
Also extend the tiled area in front of the current third row to add a FOURTH row of three EMPTY blue bench banks, giving twelve banks total, with clear aisles between all rows. Move foreground balustrade downward if needed to provide space. Keep four massage chairs and no text. Blank blue signs.
Do not change gate orientation: open north approach, checked landing south of gates, stairs down toward foreground.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make ONLY these small production cleanup changes to this station waiting hall. Preserve all architecture, layout, twelve bench banks, four massage chairs, six painted passengers with bags, lighting, style and exact image framing.
1. Boarding gates on right: remove ONLY the blue/glass swinging leaves spanning the gaps between the short silver ticket gate pedestals, including the far-left wide accessible opening. Keep all silver pedestal housings and blank blue overhead sign exactly in place. Every gap must show unobstructed cream floor between its two pedestals. Game code will draw the moving leaves.
2. From the WEST/LEFT end of the boarding gate row, add a continuous slim gold-framed glass partition extending SOUTH/DOWN to join the left side rail at the TOP of the platform staircase. This separates waiting hall on left from checked landing on right. It begins exactly at the gate row and extends only toward foreground; absolutely no partition north/above the gates, and no rail across the stair entrance. Close the current gap between the gate row and staircase's west rail.
3. Remove the small planter immediately touching the LEFT rail of the arrival escalator well, between cafe and well, replace with matching cream floor so travelers exiting at the NORTH upper landing can walk around its LEFT side via a clear narrow aisle. Keep other plants. The escalator is recessed into the 2F floor and its back/north comb opens onto the existing tiled rear landing. Keep paired steel lanes/black handrails, left down and right up.
No other changes, no new people, no text or arrows.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game character sprite atlas for a warm painted Suzhou station. Reference is existing character atlas, match watercolor/gouache shading, gentle faces, everyday clothes, proportions and lighting.
Generate SIX DIFFERENT ADULT SEATED travelers, isolated on genuine transparent background, arranged evenly in a 3 columns by 2 rows grid with generous transparent margins and no overlaps. Each full person seated facing viewer from slightly elevated frontal camera, thighs horizontal and knees bent, shoes visible below knees. No chairs or benches drawn: these seated figures will be composited onto existing blue station benches. Six poses: top left elderly woman with teal cardigan reading a small book; top middle young man in cream shirt and navy trousers checking phone; top right middle-aged woman in rust jacket holding paper cup. Bottom left older man in olive jacket hands resting on knees; bottom middle young woman in lavender sweater looking to her left; bottom right man in blue sweater reading booklet. Beside EVERY traveler at their feet include one modest rolling suitcase, backpack or duffel (vary), with bag and seated shoes aligned to same floor baseline. Bags must stay within each cell. Seated torso and head anatomy natural, legs not standing, no bench/chair pixels, no backdrop, no floor rectangle, no labels, no shadows extending into other cells. Consistent pose scale, front-facing seats, all heads below the top boundary of their cell. High quality hand painted sprites, no extra people.
